meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: Uses the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK to design protein characterization experiments, estimate costs, submit sequences, monitor laboratory progress, and retrieve results. Applies to Adaptyv Foundry, its target catalog, binding screening and affinity assays, thermostability, expression, fluorescence, epitope binning, and enzyme activity workflows, including code using adaptyv or FoundryClient.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交蛋白序列到实验室做结合与稳定性表征,并跟踪实验进度、取回结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做蛋白质工程,需要把候选序列送去实验室验证并结合结果迭代
copy.tagline_en: Submit protein sequences for lab assays, track experiment progress, and fetch results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer proteins and need candidate sequences validated in a lab.

howto.what: Claude 会接入 Adaptyv Bio 云端实验室的 API/Python SDK:替你查靶点、估算实验费用、创建并提交氨基酸序列实验、跟踪实验状态,最后取回结果。覆盖结合筛选、亲和力、热稳定性、表达量、荧光等实验类型。
howto.when: 当你提到 Adaptyv、Foundry API、蛋白结合筛选等关键词,或要求提交蛋白序列做实验表征,或代码里 import adaptyv、FoundryClient 时触发。

say.text: 用 Adaptyv 查一下 EGFR 靶点,并估算这个筛选实验的费用
say.note: 会列出匹配靶点并返回费用估算

say.text: 把这些序列提交成 BLI 结合筛选实验,做 3 个重复
say.note: 会创建实验并提交审核

say.text: 看看这个实验进行到哪一步了,顺便取回结果
say.note: 会返回当前状态和结果数据

howto.what_en: Lets Claude design protein experiments, estimate costs, submit amino acid sequences, track lab status and retrieve results through the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API/SDK, covering binding screens, affinity, thermostability and more.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Adaptyv, Foundry API or protein binding/screening assays, when code imports adaptyv or FoundryClient, or when you want to submit protein sequences for characterization.

say_en.text: Check Adaptyv for EGFR targets and estimate the cost of this screening run
say_en.note: Lists matching targets and returns a cost estimate

say_en.text: Submit these sequences as a BLI binding screen with 3 replicates
say_en.note: Creates the experiment and submits it for review

say_en.text: Show where this experiment stands and fetch its results
say_en.note: Returns current status and result data
